routes.name: Avalanche Gulch
routes.approach: From Bunny Flat, follow the trail up through red fir forest to Horse Camp and the stone Sierra Club cabin at about 7,900 ft, which has a spring and camping. Above Horse Camp, follow Olberman's Causeway, a path of laid stones, above tree line, then continue up past Spring Hill and 50/50 Flat into lower Avalanche Gulch. routes.descent: Descend the same route. When the snow is soft enough, many climbers glissade long sections of the gulch, but always take crampons off first and keep the ice axe ready to brake. In poor visibility it is easy to drift east off the route into Mud Creek

routes.name: Hotlum-Wintun Ridge
routes.approach: Start at the Brewer Creek trailhead (about 7,300 feet) on the quiet east side of the mountain. The trail is faint and disappears under snow, so head up toward the summit, which stays in view, along the open slopes south of the Brewer Creek drainage.
